computation_or_rationale: Lawsuit from a December accident: condition existed at 12/31 -> recognized (ASC 855-10-55-1a). Stock issuance, post-YE market decline and acquisition are nonrecognized (855-10-55-2).
Non-SEC filer evaluates through available-to-be-issued date (855-10-25-2) and discloses the date and whether it is issued or available-to-be-issued (855-10-50-1).
Fire after BS date = condition arose after YE -> nonrecognized; disclose nature and estimate of loss (855-10-55-2d, 50-2).
Deterioration over a year existed at 12/31 -> recognized; adjust allowance (855-10-55-1b).
Healthy at YE; tornado in January caused the bankruptcy -> condition arose after YE (855-10-55-2e); disclose if material.
SEC filer evaluates through date issued (855-10-25-1A).
Event (November) before YE -> recognized; liability 500,000 -> 350,000; reduce liability and expense by 500,000-350,000=150,000.
Split after YE before issuance -> per-share and share data retroactively adjusted (ASC 260-10-55-12).
Bond issuance after YE is nonrecognized (855-10-55-2a). (a) obsolescence at YE, (b) price of December purchase, (d) tax dispute for the year all relate to YE conditions -> recognized.
Theft in November = condition existed at YE, discovered before issuance -> adjust inventory and record loss in the year.
855-10-50-2: disclose nature of event and estimate of financial effect (or statement that estimate cannot be made).
Underlying cause (defective goods sold in November) existed at YE; info before issuance shows probable and estimable -> accrue 200,000 (ASC 450-20-25-2, 855-10-25-1).
Condition existed at YE (855-10-55-1b). Loss = 90,000 x (1-0.20) = 72,000 bad debt expense in Year 1.
Non-SEC filer -> available-to-be-issued date (855-10-25-2).
Bond issuance after YE -> nonrecognized; disclose (855-10-55-2a).
Injury in November -> recognized; liability adjusted to settlement 260,000 (+60,000).
Post-YE market decline -> nonrecognized; disclose if material (855-10-55-2g).
855-10-25-4: on reissuance, do not recognize events after original issuance/available date unless GAAP or regulation requires.
Fire after YE -> nonrecognized; disclose.
Claims data on pre-YE sales give evidence about YE estimate -> adjust YE warranty liability (855-10-25-1, estimates).
Embezzlement occurred during the year -> condition existed at YE; adjust.
Dividend declared after YE: no liability at 12/31 (declaration creates the obligation) -> disclose.
Deferred taxes use enacted rates at BS date; effect of a change recognized in period of enactment (ASC 740-10-30-8, 740-10-35-4/45-15).
Decline existed at YE -> adjust allowance.
Fire after YE -> disclose, not recognized.
Lawsuit accrued (event presumably pre-YE) settled 120,000 -> report 120,000 liability. Note: stem does not state when the underlying event occurred.
ASC 260-10-55-12: EPS restated retroactively for split.
Bond issuance after YE -> nonrecognized; disclose.
SEC filer -> date issued.
Condition (market conditions) existed at YE -> write down inventory to NRV/LCM at YE.
Decline after YE -> nonrecognized; disclose.
Bond issuance -> nonrecognized. (b) year-end accident, (c) pre-YE losses, (d) bonus based on the year's income are recognized.
Difficulties existed at YE -> recognized; adjust allowance.
